meaning: perezi: for Laureano Perez Arcas (1824–1894), Spanish zoologist
description: A heavy-bodied, streamlined reef shark with a short blunt snout, large round eyes and a dark grey to grey-brown back over a white belly. Its fins are plain, with no bold markings, and the first dorsal is tall and sickle-shaped. It patrols coral reefs and drop-offs of the western Atlantic, eating mostly bony fish, and is sometimes seen resting motionless on the bottom.
eats: Bony fish, squid, octopus and some rays
